messages.subject: Q1 UK Office Market Outlook — Manchester leads regional take-up
messages.plaintextBody:
UK OFFICE MARKET OUTLOOK — Q1

Manchester continues to lead regional office take-up, with prime yields stabilising around 6.5–7.0% and rental growth in the city core. Download the full report for sector analysis, deal comparables and our 12-month forecast.
